Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough for FinovateX

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a combined SOC 2 controls walkthrough and DPA review so your audit team can validate evidence transfer and retention controls before the pen test.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Tue Jul 8: 09:00–10:30 PT (90 min)
- Thu Jul 10: 16:00–17:30 PT (90 min)

We can compress to a 60 min slot if you prefer a narrower agenda; otherwise the 90-min format gives time for Q&A and a short evidence handoff demo. I'm attaching our SOC2_Preflight_Checklist and a short DPA summary to help your team prepare.

Action items: please confirm which window works, preferred attendee list (audit vs security), and whether you need a video bridge (we'll provide a Zoom link and an operations bridge if you want a live SFTP demo).

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: SOC2_Preflight_Checklist.pdf (pdf), DPA_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: Scheduling: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough for FinovateX

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the options. Our security team is tight that week (Q2 close) and the audit lead is OOO Jul 9–12. A couple of notes:

- Thu Jul 10 at 16:00 PT conflicts with our monthly all-hands — can't do that one.
- Tue Jul 8 at 09:00 PT *might* work for the core security folks, but our external auditor (Marta Lopez) said she prefers an afternoon slot to overlap with her East Coast schedule.

Two alternative windows that would work on our side:
- Mon Jul 7: 13:00–14:00 PT (60 min) — we can keep this tight to controls + evidence handoff
- Wed Jul 9: 14:00–15:30 PT (90 min) — broader attendance possible

Also copying procurement (procure@finovatex.com) to flag that we may need a short procurement review/cost approval; Laura, could you confirm if a 60-min briefing is fine budget-wise or whether we should schedule a follow-up?

Best,
Jordan

Jordan / Marta —

Appreciate the quick reply and the constraints. We can absolutely meet your afternoon preference so Marta can join. To keep momentum and avoid multi-round rescheduling, proposing the following consolidated options (PT):

Option A (preferred for auditor overlap):
- Wed Jul 9, 14:00–15:30 PT (90 min) — we’ll include an evidence transfer demo (SFTP/S3 examples) and a Q&A block for auditors.

Option B (compact):
- Mon Jul 7, 13:00–14:00 PT (60 min) — controls + evidence overview, follow-up deep-dive if needed.

Logistics: we will provide a Zoom link and an ops bridge. Ben, Vanessa — we'll need a brief pre-call dry run to ensure the evidence demo (SFTP keys and sample logs) can be shown without exposing customer data. Can we do a 30-min dry run Mon Jul 7 at 10:00 PT?

Procurement: Laura, Jordan copied procurement earlier — if Option B is chosen, can procurement confirm whether a single 60-min briefing is covered under the current PO or if we should route a small SOW for the extended 90-miner?

If you confirm Option A, I'll lock the invite and send the prep doc and Zoom link; if Option B, I'll send a lean agenda and the recording consent form for the auditor.

Thanks —
